entities.summary: Anthony James Keith "Tony" Hymas is an English keyboard player, pianist, and composer. In the Eighties he formed the band Ph.D., who had a Top 10 hit in the UK with the song "I Won't Let You Down" in 1982. He worked closely with Jeff Beck, recording with him on his 1980 album There & Back, and his 1989 album Jeff Beck's Guitar Shop.
